name: print-social-purple-and-blue-fintech-trust-ad-quartet-with-glass-shapes
title: Four purple and blue fintech ads with portraits, a green highlight and tilted phones
whatItIs: A 2x2 set of tall ads with headlines like 'No more "I've sent it" anxiety.' and 'Because trust shouldn't feel like a gamble.' in white on saturated purple or blue, cutout portraits holding phones, glass shapes, a green squiggle and a footer with logo and URL pill.
whatItMeans: Reassuring and vivid; colour blocks and human portraits make trust feel warm.
techniques: Use white headlines with quoted phrases.

vocabulary.definition: Ads switching between two brand colours.
A headline that quotes a user phrase.
A base bar with logo and URL.
